                                       BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2016-007
                                                  Operational


          Rescinds: Administrative Policy and Procedure Notice 1 of 2005 (APPN 1/05)

              Issuer: Gus Sirakis, P.E.
                      Assistant Commissioner for Technical Affairs and Code Development

   Issuance Date: March 30, 2016

           Purpose: This bulletin rescinds Administrative Policy and Procedure Notice (APPN) 1/05 that
                    is no longer applicable under any code.

     Related Code             1 RCNY 33-01           1 RCNY 103-04
          Section:            1 RCNY 103-02          1 RCNY 103-05

         Subject(s): APPN, rescinded; Elevator penalties; Boilers; Work without permit; Facades


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs),
Policy and Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various
memoranda, directives, and letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department
practice and incorporate new laws and regulations.

APPN 1/05 addressed elevator, boiler, façade and work without a permit penalties. The following rules
listed below supersede APPN 1/05 in its entirety as per the effective date listed with each rule.
 1 RCNY § 103-02 (effective 8/14/10) addresses elevator penalties;
 1 RCNY § 103-05 (effective 11/15/10) addresses boilers;
 1 RCNY § 33-01 (effective 2/22/14) addresses work without permit; and
 1 RCNY § 103-04 (effective 1/28/11) addresses façades.

Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the effective date of the applicable rule.
Rescinded documents will appear on the Department website with the watermark ‘RESCINDED.’

Because the process is ongoing, future Bulletins may still address documents not specifically listed in
this Bulletin.

Watermarked BBs and PPNs may be accessed through the online version of this Bulletin at:
http://www1.nyc.gov/site/buildings/codes/building-bulletins.page.
